labels.name: question
labels.rationale: Asks when pull requests will be opened to external contributors: contribution process, handled as a question.

body:
Pull requests on Rich are limited to collaborators. Contributors describe the change in an issue first, and a maintainer decides whether to take it. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md) and [AI_POLICY.md](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/AI_POLICY.md) for the process.

For the broken link, opening a documentation issue that names the page and the link is the right first step. An earlier, related request about fork pull requests is #4029.

General usage questions belong in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions).

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
